title: Citation Generator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Formats references in APA, MLA, Chicago, and other citation styles. The Citation Generator formats references in APA, MLA, Chicago, and other styles. It takes the source details — author, title, date, publisher — and produces a correctly formatted citation plus the matching in-text citation. It handles books, journal articles, websites, and videos, and flags missing details the style requires.
capabilities: Format citations in APA, MLA, Chicago, and more
Generate matching in-text citations
Handle books, articles, websites, and videos
Flag missing details a style requires
Convert a citation between styles

demo.title: Advanced pattern: readability metrics
demo.code: const text='Clear writing helps readers. Short sentences work well. Vary the length for flow.';const words=text.split(/\s+/).length;const sents=text.split('.').filter(s=>s.trim()).length;const avg=+(words/sents).toFixed(1);J({words,sentences:sents,avgWordsPerSentence:avg});assert(words===13&&sents===3&&avg===4.3,'readability');
